RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly estimate from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your PhD and eight years’ management experience make your question understandable, but a higher degree does not automatically establish stronger suitability for a leadership role. The announcement may omit relevant experience and interview performance.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and how your qualifications and interview performance were assessed. Check any complaint deadlines now; waiting for a response may not pause them.

Raise possible sex discrimination if specific evidence emerges—for example, sex-related remarks, inconsistent criteria, or different treatment—not simply because the panel consisted of women.
